name: Thick draped chariot reins with rounded transitions

parameters.design_notes: Nominal 1.16 mm source / 1.508 mm at 130%; rounded tangent joins. Steep hand-to-rump runs; remaining length rests into the horse backs, necks and bridles. Visual prototype: sliced support and physical handling checks remain outstanding.
parameters.provenance: Original parameterized primitives, rigid frames and local ordered Exact CSG.
